origin.description: Attaches text labels to selected numeric or character values.
origin.usage: labelled(x = double(), labels = NULL, label = NULL)

arguments.name: labels
arguments.text: A named vector of the same type. The names are the labels.

origin.details: Labels do not have to cover every value. They must be named and unique, ignoring missing values.
origin.example:
s2 <- labelled(c(1, 1, 2), c(Male = 1, Female = 2), label = "Assigned sex at birth")
print(s2)

translation.description: Attaches text labels to selected numeric or character values.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.text: A named vector of the same type. The names are the labels.

translation.details: Labels do not have to cover every value. They must be named and unique, ignoring missing values.
translation.example:
from haven import labelled
s2 = labelled([1, 1, 2], {"Male": 1, "Female": 2}, label="Assigned sex at birth")
print(s2.values)
print(s2.labels)
print(s2.label)
